d: Jet black hair is cut into a short, straight bob with blunt bangs. Large, expressionless charcoal-grey eyes sit on a youthful, mature face. The build is slender, wearing a light grey military-style tunic with a red collar, a matching pleated mini-skirt, and thigh-high light grey stockings with red rings at the top. Accessories include a light grey peaked cap with a single button and a large, grey ship-hull shaped mechanical armament held in the arm.
